name: SpaceX
thesis: Launch infrastructure, Starlink recurring connectivity, government/defense relationships and Starship-driven cost optionality create a vertically integrated space infrastructure platform.
anti_thesis: Valuation may outrun cash generation; Starship development, capex intensity, regulation, governance concentration or execution delays may compress future returns.
kill_criteria: Sustained deterioration in Starlink subscriber economics or churn
Starship fails to reach economically useful reuse within the thesis window
Governance or capital allocation materially impairs minority shareholder economics
Valuation rises enough that expected 10-year return falls below the portfolio hurdle rate

next_action.action: Refresh valuation and run full committee review with current verified market and filing data
